Exercise: Two-Arm Kettlebell Row

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- bilateral_row

Primary Muscles:

- middle back

Secondary Muscles:

- biceps
- lats

Equipment:

- kettlebells

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
ATP-PC and glycolytic

Recovery Time:
1.5 hours

Goals:

- develop_strength_in_the_middle_back_and_biceps
- improve_overall_pulling_ability

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury
- Lower back pain

Exercise Variations:

- name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Row with Alternating Grip, description: Use one overhand and one underhand grip.
- name: One-Arm Kettlebell Row, description: Perform the exercise with one arm at a time.

Substitution Options:

- name: Barbell Row, equipment: barbell
- name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row, equipment: dumbbells

Instructions:

- Place two kettlebells in front of your feet. Bend your knees slightly and then push your butt out as much as possible as you bend over to get in the starting position.
- Grab both kettlebells and pull them to your stomach, retracting your shoulder blades and flexing the elbows. Keep your back straight. Lower and repeat.
